summary: Enhance your skills with our Complete Data Protection and Privacy Training Course. Learn essential strategies to safeguard data and ensure compliance.
lede: Data protection training helps professionals who manage personal data turn privacy obligations into repeatable workflows. It covers mapping data flows, assessing privacy risks with DPIA and LINDDUN methods, and designing controls for individual-rights requests, retention, deletion and third-party oversight. Learners also develop processing records, control ownership matrices and privacy dashboards using frameworks including ISO/IEC 27701 and the NIST Privacy Framework.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage personal data obligations, privacy controls, digital processing risks, or accountability evidence. It suits experienced practitioners and leaders who need to translate data protection and privacy requirements into repeatable operational workflows.
modules: NIST Privacy Framework Data Protection Training Assessment
LINDDUN Data Protection Training Risk Analysis
OECD Guidelines Rights and Supplier Oversight
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and have working knowledge of how your organization collects, uses, shares, retains, or deletes personal data. Access to confidential organizational records is unnecessary because the course uses provided scenarios and sample datasets. Advanced privacy engineering, AI privacy assessment, and automated data discovery are taught at an operational application level rather than a technical engineering level. Coding is not required for completion.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
